name: MongoDB Atlas
description: MongoDB Atlas lets agents list projects and clusters, inspect databases and collections, and run queries, in read-only or read-write mode as the organization owner allows. Each user signs in to their own MongoDB Atlas account through the browser.

prompts.text: List the clusters in my Atlas projects and their status.
Describe the schema of the orders collection.
Find the ten most recent orders with a status of pending.

apps.name: MongoDB Atlas
apps.description: Cluster, database, and collection access, over MongoDB's MCP server with browser sign-in.
